z’ubuvuzi” bivuga inyandiko,
amajwi cyangwa amashusho,
bikubiyemo amakuru yerekeye
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
yakusanyijwe n’ukora umwuga
wo kuvura;
(d) “ikigo cy’ubuvuzi” bivuga ikigo
gitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
cyemewe na Minisiteri;
(e) “ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi”
bivuga ikoreshwa ry’ubuhanga,
ubumenyi n’ibikoresho
koranabuhanga mu gutanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(f) “kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi”
bivuga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
zishingiye ku ikoranabuhanga mu
buvuzi, zihabwa abafite ibibazo
byo kororoka mu buryo busanzwe
hagamijwe kubafasha kubona
urubyaro;
(g) “Minisiteri” bivuga Minisiteri ifite
serivisi z’ubuvuzi mu nshingano;
(h) “Minisitiri” bivuga Minisitiri
ufite serivisi z’ubuvuzi mu
nshingano;
(i) “serivisi z’ubuvuzi” hakubiyemo
guteza imbere ubuzima bwiza
bw’abantu, gukumira indwara,
kuvura indwara zikira n’izidakira,
kugabanya ububabare buturuka ku
ndwara no gufasha umurwayi
gusubira mu buzima busanzwe;
(j) “serivisi z’ubuvuzi zihutirwa”
bivuga ubuvuzi bwihuse buhabwa
umuntu wahuye n’ikibazo
cy’ubuzima gishobora kugira
ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima
bwe, gisaba kwitabwaho
byihutirwa kugira ngo hakumirwe
ko ubuzima bwe bukomeza kujya
mu kaga, akaba yakurizamo
ubumuga cyangwa urupfu;
(k) “ubuvuzi bw’ibanze” bivuga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangwa ku
rwego rwa mbere rw’inzego za
serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(l) “ubuvuzi bw’ikirenga” bivuga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangirwa ku
rwego rusumba izindi mu rwego
rw’ubuvuzi, rurimo inzobere
n’ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
riteye imbere, zigahabwa
abarwayi bafite ibibazo
by’ubuzima bidashobora
gukemurirwa ku rwego
rw’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze cyangwa
bwisumbuye;
(m) “ubuvuzi bwisumbuye” bivuga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangirwa ku
rwego rw’ubuvuzi bwisumbuye
zidashobora gutangirwa ku
rwego rw’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze;
(n) “ubuzima” hakubiyemo
imimerere myiza mu mubiri, mu
mutwe no mu mibereho,
bitavuze ko nta ndwara cyangwa
ubumuga umuntu afite;
(o) “udashobora kwiyemerera”
bivuga umuntu udashobora
kwifatira icyemezo kuri serivisi
z’ubuvuzi kubera imwe mu
mpamvu zikurikira:
(i) kuba afite munsi y’imyaka
15 y’amavuko;
(ii) kuba afite ubushobozi buke
bw’ubwonko, uburwayi
bwo mu mutwe cyangwa
kwangirika k’ubwonko
bitewe n’uburwayi cyangwa
ihungabana;
(p) “uhagarariye ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi” hakubiyemo umwe
muri aba bakurikira:
(i) umubyeyi we;
(ii) umwana we ufite imyaka
y’ubukure;
(iii) uwo bashyingiranywe;
(iv) umuvandimwe we ufite
imyaka y’ubukure;
(v) umurera wemewe
n’amategeko;
(vi) undi wagenwa mu
bushishozi bw’ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi mu nyungu
z’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi.
(q) “ukora umwuga wo kuvura”
bivuga umuntu wanditswe kandi
wahawe uruhushya n’urugaga
rw’abakora umwuga wo kuvura
kugira ngo atange serivisi
z’ubuvuzi;
(r) “ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi”
bivuga umuntu uhabwa serivisi
z’ubuvuzi;
(s) “ukwiyemerera” bivuga
kwemera ku bushake guhabwa
serivisi y’ubuvuzi k’ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi cyangwa
umuhagarariye nyuma yo
gusobanurirwa no kumva neza
imiterere ya serivisi y’ubuvuzi
agiye guhabwa, uko bikorwa,
uburenganzira bwe, inshingano
ze, ingaruka n’inyungu
bishobora guturuka kuri iyo
serivisi y’ubuvuzi agiye
guhabwa;
(t) “umujyanama w’ubuzima”
bivuga umuntu uhabwa
amahugurwa kugira ngo
yunganire urwego rw’ubuzima
mu guha abaturage serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze;
(u) “umurwayi” bivuga ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi ufite uburwayi
cyangwa igikomere haba ku
mubiri cyangwa mu mutwe
byemejwe n’ukora umwuga wo
kuvura;
(v) “umwuga wo kuvura” bivuga
umwuga ukubiyemo umurimo
wo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi no
guteza imbere ubuzima;
(w) “urugaga rw’abakora
umwuga wo kuvura” bivuga
urwego rushyiraho amabwiriza
agena uburyo bwo gusuzuma
ubumenyi ngiro n’ubushobozi
ukora umwuga wo kuvura
agomba kuba afite n’amahame
ngengamyitwarire bijyanye
n’inshingano zarwo, rushinzwe
kwandika no gutanga uruhushya
ku bakora umwuga wo kuvura
bafite impamyabumenyi
n’ubushobozi bisabwa kandi
rukagenzura ko bawukora mu
buryo bunoze;
(x) “uwemerewe gutwitirwa”
bivuga abashyingiranywe
cyangwa undi muntu byemejwe
n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura ko
badashobora kororoka mu buryo
busanzwe, basaba gutwitirwa
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga
mu buvuzi;
(y) “uwemerewe gutwitira undi”
bivuga umugore wemera gutwita
hadakoreshejwe intanga ze no
kubyarira uwemerewe
gutwitirwa hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
akamuha umwana akivuka.

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iri tegeko Iri tegeko rireba serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangwa n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura n’izitangwa
articles.text: n’umujyanama w’ubuzima.

articles.heading: Intego ya serivisi z’ubuvuzi Intego ya serivisi z’ubuvuzi ni uko zigerwaho n’abazikeneye, zifite ireme kandi zijyanye
articles.text:
n’igihe.
UMUTWE WA II: IMITANGIRE YA
SERIVISI Z’UBUVUZI
Icyiciro cya mbere: Serivisi z’ubuvuzi
muri rusange

articles.heading: Inzego za serivisi z’ubuvuzi (1) Serivisi z’ubuvuzi ziri mu nzego zikurikira
Aho serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangirwa (1) Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangirwa mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi, uretse aho ukoresha serivisi
articles.text:
z’ubuvuzi agana umujyanama
w’ubuzima.
(2) Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zishobora gutangirwa
hanze y’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi byemejwe na
Minisiteri.

articles.heading: Kudahagarara kwa serivisi z’ubuvuzi Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangwa buri munsi, amasaha 24 kuri 24. Icyakora, serivisi
articles.text:
z’ubuvuzi zishobora gutangwa amasaha ari
munsi ya 24 bitewe n’uruhushya rwo
gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
cyahawe.

articles.heading: Kuvura umurwayi aba mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi Ukora umwuga wo kuvura ashobora kwemeza ko umurwayi avurwa aba mu kigo
articles.text:
cy’ubuvuzi bitewe na serivisi z’ubuvuzi
akeneye. Kuvura umurwayi aba mu kigo
cy’ubuvuzi bikorerwa mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi
cyabiherewe uruhushya.

articles.heading: Guha umwana ukivuka ikirango n’icyemezo cy’amavuko (1) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura aha umwana ukivuka ikirango na kode yihariye ihuye
articles.text:
n’iy’uwamubyaye kugira ngo hirindwe
kwitiranya abana bakivuka. Icyo kirango
gishyirwaho amazina y’uwamubyaye,
itariki n’igihe yavukiye.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura aha kandi
umwana ukivuka icyemezo cy’amavuko.

articles.heading: Kohereza ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku kindi kigo cy’ubuvuzi cyangwa mu yindi serivisi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyohereza ukoresha
articles.text:
serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku kindi kigo
cy’ubuvuzi gifite serivisi z’ubuvuzi
akeneye icyo kigo cy’ubuvuzi
kimwohereje kitashoboye kumuha.
(2) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishobora kohereza
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku rwego ruri
munsi y’urwego yavurirwagaho kugira
ngo ahakomereze ubuvuzi.
(3) Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi woherejwe
ku kindi kigo cy’ubuvuzi ahabwa
inyandiko imwohereza ikubiyemo
amakuru y’uburwayi bwe, amateka
y’ubuzima bwe arebana n’ubuvuzi,
serivisi z’ubuvuzi yahawe n’impamvu yo
koherezwa.
(4) Mu kigo kimwe cy’ubuvuzi, ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi ashobora kuva muri
serivisi imwe akoherezwa mu yindi
bitewe na serivisi y’ubuvuzi akeneye.
Icyo gihe hakorwa inyandiko iherekeza
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi isobanura
impamvu yo koherezwa.

articles.heading: Gusezerera ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi (1) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura usezereye ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ahita amuha
articles.text:
raporo imusezerera cyangwa igahabwa
umuhagarariye.
(2) Raporo yo gusezerera ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi igaragaza –
(a) incamake y’imiterere y’ubuzima
bw’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
serivisi z’ubuvuzi n’imiti yahawe;
(b) n’impamvu zatuma akomeza
gukurikiranwa, inama
n’amabwiriza yo gukomeza
ubuvuzi, iyo bihari.
(3) Raporo yo gusezerera ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi igomba kuba yanditse muri
rumwe mu ndimi zemewe mu butegetsi
ariko ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
cyangwa umuhagarariye
agasobanurirwa ibiyikubiyemo.

articles.heading: Kwemeza urupfu (1) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura ubifitiye ububasha, nyuma yo gusuzuma uguhagarara burundu kw’imikorere yose
articles.text:
y’umubiri w’umuntu, yemeza urupfu
kandi akandika mu ifishi y’ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi igihe urupfu rwabereye
n’icyaruteye.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura akora kandi
kopi ebyiri z’icyemezo cy’urupfu
cyerekana ibisobanuro birambuye ku
bijyanye n’imiterere y’uburwayi, icyateye
urupfu n’ibikorwa byose by’ubutabazi
cyangwa ubuvuzi byakorewe ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi upfuye. Kopi imwe
ihabwa umuryango w’uwapfuye indi
ikabikwa n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi ku buryo
amakuru ashobora kuboneka, igihe
yakenerwa.
(3) Nyuma yo kwemeza urupfu no gukora
icyemezo cy’urupfu, ukora umwuga wo
kuvura yohereza umubiri w’umuntu
wapfuye mu buruhukiro igihe umuryango
we utiteguye guhita uwutwara.
(4) Umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye woherejwe
mu buruhukiro ushyirwaho ikirango
kigaragaza amazina n’imyaka bye, itariki
n’isaha yapfiriyeho, gihambiriye neza ku
bujana bw’ukuboko cyangwa
ubw’ukuguru cyangwa ku ino kugira ngo
byoroshye kugaragara no kugerwaho.
(5) Iyo umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye udafite
amaguru n’amaboko, ukora umwuga wo
kuvura ashyira ikirango ku kindi gice
cy’umubiri.

articles.heading: Umugore upfuye atwite (1) Mu gihe umugore apfuye atwite inda igejeje nibura ku byumweru 22 ariko
articles.text:
umwana akiri muzima, ukora umwuga wo
kuvura wemeje urupfu rwe yihutira
gukora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo
arokore ubuzima bw’umwana. Iyo
umwana yapfiriye mu nda atandukanywa
na nyina.
(2) Iyo umugore apfuye atwite inda iri munsi
y’ibyumweru 22, umubiri we
ntutandukanywa n’uw’umwana yari
atwite.

articles.heading: Umugore utwite umwana yamupfiriye mu nda Ukora umwuga wo kuvura usuzumye umugore utwite akemeza ko umwana atwite
articles.text:
yapfiriye mu nda, amuha ubufasha bwihuse
bwo kumubyaza kugira ngo harengerwe
ubuzima bwe hakurikijwe amabwiriza
y’ubuvuzi abigenga.

articles.heading: Isuzuma ry’icyateye urupfu Iyo bisabwe n’ufitanye isano n’umuntu wapfuye ishingiye ku buvandimwe, uwo
articles.text:
bashyingiranywe, umurera wemewe
n’amategeko cyangwa urwego rubifitiye
ububasha, ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ubifitiye ububasha akora isuzuma ry’umubiri
w’umuntu wapfuye, hagamijwe kumenya
icyateye urupfu.

articles.heading: Gushyikiriza umuryango umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye (1) Mbere yo gushyikiriza umuryango umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye, ukora
articles.text:
umwuga wo kuvura abanza kugenzura
umwirondoro we no kureba ko ibisabwa
byose byuzuye hakurikijwe amabwiriza
y’ubuvuzi abigenga.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura ashyikiriza
umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye umwe mu
bagize umuryango we. Icyakora, iyo
havutse amakimbirane ashingiye ku
kumenya ufite uburenganzira bwo
gushyikirizwa umubiri w’umuntu
wapfuye, ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gifatanyije
n’ubuyobozi bw’urwego rw’imitegekere
y’Igihugu rwegerejwe abaturage ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi giherereyemo bagena
uwushyikirizwa.
(3) Mu bushishozi bw’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi ku
bufatanye n’urwego rw’imitegekere
y’Igihugu rwegerejwe abaturage ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi giherereyemo, umubiri
w’umuntu wapfuye ushobora
gushyikirizwa umuntu ugaragaza
ubushake bwo kuwushyingura iyo nta
muntu n’umwe mu bagize umuryango we
ubonetse ngo awushyikirizwe.
(4) Ushyikirijwe umubiri w’umuntu
wapfuye abanza kuwugenzura, agashyira
igikumwe cyangwa umukono ku
nyandiko yemeza ko awushyikirijwe.

articles.heading: Iyakirwa n’imicungire by’umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye woherejwe mu buruhukiro (1) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura wita ku
articles.text:
mibiri y’abantu bapfuye mu buruhukiro
wakiriye umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye,
ukihagera agenzura inyandiko
ikubiyemo umwirondoro n’ibindi
bisabwa hakurikijwe amategeko
n’imirongo ngenderwaho mu buvuzi.
(2) Umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye wakiriwe
mu buruhukiro wandikwa mu gitabo
cyabugenewe cyandikwamo nibura –
(a) amazina y’umuntu wapfuye,
imyaka ye, icyateye urupfu,
igihugu, Akarere n’Umurenge
yakomokagamo;
(b) amazina y’ukora umwuga wo
kuvura wemeje urupfu;
(c) amazina y’uwazanye umubiri
w’umuntu wapfuye mu
buruhukiro;
(d) n’amazina y’uwakiriye umubiri
w’umuntu wapfuye.
(3) Iyo ibiteganywa mu gika cya (2)(a)
bitabonetse, ukora umwuga wo kuvura
wakiriye umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye,
yandika ibiranga imiterere y’umubiri
w’umuntu wapfuye yakiriye harimo,
uburebure n’ikigero cy’imyaka.
(4) Umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye ubikwa mu
buryo buwurinda kwangirika binyuze
mu kuwukorera igenzura rihoraho
kugira ngo hatabaho ishanguka
ry’umubiri ryihuse.

articles.heading: Gushyingura umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye wabuze bene wo (1) Umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye wabuze bene wo ushobora gushyingurwa n’ikigo
articles.text:
cy’ubuvuzi iyo kimaze gukora ibi
bikurikira:
(a) kumenyesha ishami ry’urwego rufite
ubugenzacyaha mu nshingano
rikorera mu ifasi y’aho giherereye mu
gihe kitarenze amasaha 24 hemejwe
urupfu, kugira ngo rigire icyo
ribivugaho;
(b) gutanga itangazo mu gihe kitarenze
amasaha 24 hemejwe urupfu kuri
radiyo yumvwa na benshi mu
Rwanda rikanyuzwaho nibura
inshuro eshatu no muri kimwe mu
binyamakuru byandika gikorera mu
Rwanda gisomwa na benshi;
(c) gutegereza ko hashira iminsi irindwi
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi wa mbere
itangazo ryatangiweho.
(2) Iyo ishami ry’urwego rufite
ubugenzacyaha mu nshingano ritagize
icyo rivuga mu gihe cy’iminsi irindwi
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
rwamenyesherejweho, ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
gishyingura umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye
wabuze bene wo.
(3) Igihe cy’iminsi irindwi giteganywa muri
iyi ngingo gishobora kutageraho iyo
umubiri w’umuntu wapfuye bigaragara
ko wangiritse cyane byemejwe mu
nyandiko n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura.

articles.heading: Raporo y’ubuvuzi yuzuye Iyo bisabwe n’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi cyangwa umuhagarariye, ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
gitanga raporo y’ubuvuzi yuzuye ikubiyemo
serivisi zose z’ubuvuzi n’impamvu zatanzwe
n’uko ubuzima bw’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi buhagaze. Iyo raporo y’ubuvuzi
yuzuye itangwa mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
itanu y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
cyayisabiweho.

articles.heading: Inyandiko y’impuguke mu by’ubuvuzi (1) Inyandiko y’impuguke mu by’ubuvuzi itangwa n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyangwa
articles.text:
impuguke mu by’ubuvuzi bisabwe mu
nyandiko n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Impuguke mu by’ubuvuzi ikora
inyandiko y’impuguke mu by’ubuvuzi
ikubiyemo amakuru areba ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi, kugira ngo afashe
urwego rwayisabye gusobanukirwa
amakuru y’ubuvuzi cyangwa
kuyashingiraho mu gufata icyemezo ku
kibazo gisuzumwa.
Icyiciro cya 2: Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zijyanye
n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere y’abantu

articles.heading: Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere y’abantu Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zijyanye n’ubuzima
Kubika, gukoresha intanga cyangwa urusoro (1) Kubika, gukoresha intanga cyangwa urusoro kugira ngo byifashishwe mu
articles.text:
gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi zerekeye
kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi, bikorwa
n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyabiherewe
uruhushya.
(2) Ushaka ko intanga cyangwa urusoro
bye bibikwa kugira ngo bizakoreshwe
mu gihe kizaza abisaba ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi mu nyandiko bigakorwa
hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.
(3) Intanga cyangwa urusoro bibikwa mu
kigo cy’ubuvuzi mu gihe cy’imyaka
icumi. Icyakora, igihe icyo ari cyo
cyose uwasabye ko intanga cyangwa
urusoro bibikwa ashobora gusaba ko
bidakomeza kubikwa.
(4) Iyo uwasabye ko intanga cyangwa
urusoro bibikwa atishyuye ikiguzi
cyagenwe, ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
ntigikomeza kubibika.
(5) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ikiguzi
cyishyurwa ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kibika
intanga cyangwa urusoro.

articles.heading: Abemerewe gukoresha uburyo bwo kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi (1) Abashyingiranywe cyangwa undi
articles.text:
muntu byemejwe n’ukora umwuga wo
kuvura ko badashobora kororoka mu
buryo busanzwe ni bo bemerewe
kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rishyiraho Komite
ishinzwe gukurikirana ibikorwa byo
kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
rikanagena imiterere n’imikorere
byayo.

articles.heading: Ukora umwuga wo kuvura wemerewe gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi zifasha kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
articles.text:
Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zifasha kororoka
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
zitangwa n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ubifitiye ububasha harimo inzobere mu
buvuzi bw’imyororokere y’abantu cyangwa
inzobere mu buvuzi bw’indwara z’abagore
yahawe amahugurwa yemewe mu buhanga
bw’imyororokere.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa utanga intanga cyangwa urusoro (1) Utanga intanga cyangwa urusoro kugira ngo bihabwe uwemerewe kororoka
articles.text:
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu
buvuzi, asabwa –
(a) gushyira igikumwe cyangwa
umukono ku nyandiko
y’ukwiyemerera;
(b) gutanga umwirondoro we wuzuye;
(c) kuba afite nibura imyaka 21
y’amavuko;
(d) no kuba yarakorewe isuzuma ryuzuye
ry’indwara n’iry’ibijyanye
n’imyororokere rigaragaza ko
ashobora gutanga intanga.
(2) Umuntu ufite nibura imyaka 18
y’amavuko ariko utaragira imyaka 21
y’amavuko ashobora kwemererwa
gutanga intanga ku mpamvu zumvikana
iyo abisabye Minisitiri mu nyandiko.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena imyaka
ntarengwa ku utanga intanga.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa uhabwa intanga cyangwa urusoro Uhabwa intanga cyangwa urusoro hagamijwe kumufasha kororoka
articles.text:
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi,
asabwa –
(a) gushyira igikumwe cyangwa umukono
ku nyandiko y’ukwiyemerera;
(b) kuba afite nibura imyaka 21 y’amavuko;
(c) no kuba yarakorewe isuzuma ryuzuye
ry’indwara n’iry’ibijyanye
n’imyororokere rigaragaza ko
adashobora kororoka mu buryo
busanzwe.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa uwemerewe gutwitira undi (1) Uwemerewe gutwitira undi asabwa – (a) kuba afite nibura imyaka 21 ariko
articles.text:
atarengeje imyaka 40 y’amavuko;
(b) kuba yarabashije gutwita kugeza
abyaye nta kibazo;
(c) no kuba isuzumwa yakorewe n’ukora
umwuga wo kuvura rigaragaza ko
afite ubuzima bwiza ku buryo
ashobora gutwita no kubyara nta
kibazo.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena inshuro zo
gutwita uwemerewe gutwitira undi
atarenza n’uburyo akorerwa isuzumwa
rigaragaza ko afite ubuzima bwiza.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’uwemerewe gutwitirwa Uwemerewe gutwitirwa afite inshingano zikurikira
Inshingano z’uwemerewe gutwitira undi Uwemerewe gutwitira undi afite inshingano zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) gutwita no gukurikiza inama na serivisi
z’ubuvuzi ahabwa n’ukora umwuga wo
kuvura;
(b) kwirinda ibikorwa n’imyitwarire
bishobora gushyira mu kaga ubuzima
bwe n’ubw’umwana atwite;
(c) kumenyesha mu buryo buhoraho usaba
gutwitirwa amakuru ku buzima bwe
cyangwa ubw’umwana atwite;
(d) guha uwemerewe gutwitirwa umwana
akimara kumubyara.

articles.heading: Amasezerano hagati y’uwemerewe gutwitirwa n’uwemerewe gutwitira undi (1) Uwemerewe gutwitirwa n’uwemeye
articles.text:
kumutwitira bakorana amasezerano
imbere ya noteri mbere yo guhabwa
serivisi y’ubuvuzi yo gutwitira undi.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena iby’ingenzi
bikubiye mu masezerano akorwa hagati
y’uwemerewe gutwitirwa n’uwemerewe
gutwitira undi.

articles.heading: Ibibujijwe ku birebana na serivisi z’ubuvuzi zifasha kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
articles.text:
Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zifasha kororoka
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
zirabujijwe muri ibi bikurikira:
(a) guhindura utunyangingo tw’umuntu;
(b) guhitamo igitsina cy’umwana
uzavuka;
(c) gukoresha intanga cyangwa urusoro
hatagaragara umwirondoro wuzuye
w’uwabitanze;
(d) gutanga intanga cyangwa urusoro
bikomoka ku muntu umwe ku
bemerewe kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi barenze
umwe;
(e) kugura cyangwa kugurisha intanga
cyangwa urusoro;
(f) kugura cyangwa kugurisha serivisi yo
gutwitira undi;
(g) gukoresha intanga hagamijwe gukora
urusoro uwatanze iyo ntanga
atabyiyemereye;
(h) gutanga intanga y’umwe mu
bashyingiranywe undi atabyemeye;
(i) guha intanga cyangwa urusoro umwe
mu bashyingiranywe undi
atabyemeye;
(j) gutwitira undi cyangwa gusaba
gutwitirwa uwo bashyingiranywe
atabyemeye;
(k) gukoresha intanga cyangwa urusoro
nyuma y’urupfu rw’ababitanze,
uretse iyo biyemereye mu nyandiko
ko bishobora gukoreshwa batakiriho
cyangwa ari umwe mu
bashyingiranywe ushaka
kubikoresha;
(l) guhuza intanga z’abantu bafitanye
isano ishingiye ku buvandimwe
itaziguye;
(m)guhuza intanga z’abantu bafitanye
isano ishingiye ku buvandimwe
iziguye kugeza ku gisanira cya
karindwi ;
(n) gutanga cyangwa kwakira intanga
kugira ngo ihuzwe n’iy’umuntu
mufitanye isano ishingiye ku
buvandimwe itaziguye;
(o) gutanga cyangwa kwakira intanga
kugira ngo ihuzwe n’iy’umuntu
mufitanye isano ishingiye ku
buvandimwe iziguye kugeza ku
gisanira cya karindwi ;
(p) gushyira mu myanya myibarukiro
y’umugore intanga cyangwa urusoro
bitari iby’umuntu;
(q) gutumiza cyangwa kohereza mu
mahanga intanga cyangwa urusoro,
uretse igihe Minisiteri itanze mu
nyandiko uruhushya rwihariye.
Icyiciro cya 3: Serivisi z’ubuvuzi zihariye
zihabwa ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe

articles.heading: Gushyira mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe atabyiyemereye (1) Ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo
articles.text:
mu mutwe ashobora gushyirwa mu kigo
cy’ubuvuzi atabyiyemereye mu gihe
kitarenze amasaha 48 kugira ngo
akorerwe isuzuma ry’ubuzima ry’ibanze
hemezwe ikibazo afite n’uburyo bwo
kumwitaho. Icyakora, ukora umwuga wo
kuvura ashobora kwemeza ko ufite
uburwayi bwo mu mutwe akomeza
kuvurwa ari mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 30 ishobora kongerwa
hashingiwe ku isuzumwa rikorwa
n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura asuzuma ko
ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo
mu mutwe yujuje ibigenderwaho kugira
ngo ashyirwe mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi
atabyiyemereye, birimo kugaragaza
ibishobora kumuteza ibyago cyangwa
kubiteza abandi, kutabasha kwiyitaho
cyangwa kutabasha kwifatira icyemezo.

articles.heading: Uwemerewe gusabira ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe gushyirwa mu kigo cy’ubuvuzi
Uburyo bwo kwita ku murwayi ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe ushobora gushyira ubuzima bwe cyangwa
articles.text:
ubw’abandi mu kaga
(1) Umurwayi ufite uburwayi bwo mu
mutwe ushobora gushyira ubuzima bwe
cyangwa ubw’abandi mu kaga, nyuma yo
gusuzumwa, ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ashobora –
(a) kumuha imiti imugabanyiriza
ububabare cyangwa imufasha
gutuza;
(b) kumushyira ahantu ha wenyine
hagamijwe kurinda umutekano
we n’uw’abandi;
(c) cyangwa kumufasha gutuza
hakoreshejwe ibikoresho
byabugenewe.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura akora isuzuma
rihoraho, kugira ngo amenye niba
umurwayi ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe
adashobora kwiteza ibyago cyangwa
kubiteza abandi, agahagarika uburyo bwo
kumufasha gutuza.

articles.heading: Isuzumwa ry’ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe ukurikiranweho icyaha (1) Bisabwe n’urwego rw’ubutabera,
articles.text:
ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo
mu mutwe ukurikiranweho icyaha
n’inzego z’ubutabera akorerwa
isuzumwa n’abaganga nibura batatu
bagakora raporo bakayitanga mu gihe
cyagenwe n’amategeko abigenga
akanitabwaho hakurikijwe ibyavuye mu
isuzumwa ryakozwe.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo
ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo
mu mutwe ukurikiranweho icyaha
n’inzego z’ubutabera yitabwaho.

articles.heading: Imicungire y’ibintu by’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo mu mutwe
articles.text:
cyangwa ufite ikibazo gituma adashobora
kwifatira icyemezo
Ukora umwuga wo kuvura wakiriye
ukekwaho cyangwa ufite uburwayi bwo mu
mutwe cyangwa ufite ikibazo gituma
adashobora kwifatira icyemezo akora
inyandikomvugo igaragaza ibintu
yamwakiriye afite kandi akabishyikiriza
ubuyobozi bw’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kugira ngo
hitabwe ku micungire yabyo.
Icyiciro cya 4: Gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi

articles.heading: Gukoresha ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi (1) Ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi ryemewe nka bumwe mu buryo bwo gutanga
articles.text:
serivisi z’ubuvuzi.
(2) Ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
rikoreshwa mu gutanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi mu buryo bujyanye
n’igihe, bwihuse kandi bunoze.

articles.heading: Uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishaka gutanga
articles.text:
serivisi z’ubuvuzi hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi gisaba
Minisitiri uruhushya mu nyandiko.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibipimo
n’imirongo ngenderwaho bigenga
imitangire ya serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangwa
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu
buvuzi. Rigena kandi ibyerekeye itangwa
ry’uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi zitangwa hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi ku kigo
cy’ubuvuzi.

articles.heading: Umutekano n’ibanga mu gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi (1) Mu gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
hubahirizwa amategeko yerekeye
kurinda amakuru bwite.
(2) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishyiraho uburyo bwo
kurinda amakuru y’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi, mu nzira anyuramo no mu
bubiko bwayo.
Icyiciro cya 5 : Igiciro n’ikiguzi bya serivisi
z’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Igiciro cya serivisi y’ubuvuzi (1) Serivisi y’ubuvuzi yahawe ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi yishyurwa hashingiwe
articles.text:
ku giciro cyashyizweho na Minisiteri.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena igiciro cya
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zitangwa n’ibigo
by’ubuvuzi.

articles.heading: Ikiguzi kijyanye na serivisi z’ubuvuzi zo kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi (1) Ikiguzi cya serivisi y’ubuvuzi ijyanye no
articles.text:
kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga
mu buvuzi cyishyurwa n’uwemerewe
kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga
mu buvuzi.
(2) Serivisi y’ubuvuzi ijyanye no kororoka
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
yishyurwa n’ubwishingizi
bw’uwemerewe kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi iyo
buyishingira.
UMUTWE WA III: IMITUNGANYIRIZE
Y’UMWUGA WO KUVURA

articles.heading: Ibyiciro by’abatanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi (1) Ibyiciro by’abatanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi ni ibi bikurikira
Imikorere y’ibyiciro by’abakora umwuga wo kuvura n’abajyanama b’ubuzima (1) Imikorere ya buri cyiciro cy’abakora
articles.text:
umwuga wo kuvura igengwa
n’amategeko, amahame n’amabwiriza
bigenga ubuvuzi. Igengwa kandi
n’amahame n’amabwiriza
ngengamyitwarire bishyirwaho
n’urugaga rw’abakora umwuga wo
kuvura bireba.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena imikorere
y’abajyanama b’ubuzima n’uburyo
bashyirwaho.

articles.heading: Kwandika no guha uruhushya ukora umwuga wo kuvura Ushaka gukora umwuga wo kuvura yandikwa kandi agahabwa uruhushya
articles.text:
n’urugaga rw’abakora umwuga wo kuvura
hakurikijwe impamyabumenyi, ubushobozi
n’icyiciro cy’umwuga wo kuvura ashaka
gukoramo.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa ushaka gukora umwuga wo kuvura Ushaka gukora umwuga wo kuvura agomba kuba –
articles.text:
(a) afite impamyabumenyi yemewe;
(b) kandi afite uruhushya rutangwa
n’urugaga rw’abakora umwuga
wo kuvura bireba.

articles.heading: Kwimenyereza umwuga no kongera ubumenyi (1) Mbere yo gutangira gukora umwuga wo kuvura, ubifitiye impamyabumenyi
articles.text:
yemewe, yimenyereza umwuga mu kigo
cyemerewe kwakira abimenyereza.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura yongera
ubumenyi bugamije kumufasha gutanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zijyanye n’igihe
cyangwa kubona impamyabumenyi
yisumbuye mu mwuga wo kuvura.
(3)Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibyiciro
by’abakora umwuga wo kuvura babanza
kwimenyereza umwuga no kongera
ubumenyi n’uburyo bwo kwimenyereza
umwuga no kongera ubumenyi bikorwa.

articles.heading: Kwemeza ubushobozi no gutanga uburenganzira bwihariye (1) Kwemeza ubushobozi bw’ukora umwuga
articles.text:
wo kuvura hakubiyemo igikorwa cyo
kugenzura no gusuzuma ubushobozi
bw’ukora umwuga wo kuvura.
(2) Gutanga uburenganzira bwihariye bivuga
guha ukora umwuga wo kuvura
uburenganzira bwo gutanga serivisi
zirenze ku zo yemerewe gukora nyuma
yo kwemeza ubushobozi.
(3) Kwemeza ubushobozi no gutanga
uburenganzira bwihariye ku ukora
umwuga wo kuvura bigenwa
n’amategeko abigenga.
UMUTWE WA IV: IMYITWARIRE
Y’ABAKORA UMWUGA WO KUVURA

articles.heading: Kubahiriza icyubahiro n’agaciro bya muntu Ukora umwuga wo kuvura – (a) aharanira ko uburenganzira, agaciro,
articles.text:
umuco n’imyemerere bya muntu
byubahirizwa;
(b) kandi agaharanira ko ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi cyangwa
umuhagarariye ahabwa amakuru
ajyanye na serivisi z’ubuvuzi akeneye
kugira ngo ayashingireho afata
icyemezo.

articles.heading: Guhana amakuru mu gihe cyo gusimburana Mu gihe cyo gusimburana, ukora umwuga wo kuvura aha umusimbuye amakuru
articles.text:
y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi, akamwereka
ibyakozwe, ibitarakorwa n’ibigomba
gukorwa kugira ngo hakomeze gutangwa
serivisi z’ubuvuzi.

articles.heading: Kudahunga inshingano Ukora umwuga wo kuvura yirinda kwirengagiza, kudatanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
za ngombwa yitezweho, kudafata icyemezo
amategeko amutegeka cyangwa gutererana
bagenzi be abaha imirimo iri mu nshingano
ze.

articles.heading: Kugira ibanga Ukora umwuga wo kuvura agira ibanga ry’amakuru yerekeranye n’imiterere y’ubuzima bw’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
Icyakora, ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ashobora gutanga amakuru y’imiterere
y’ubuzima bw’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
abisabwe iyo –
(a) ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
yiyemereye mu nyandiko ko amakuru
y’imiterere y’ubuzima bwe atangazwa
ku mpamvu z’ubushakashatsi
cyangwa igenamigambi mu
by’ubuzima;
(b) gutangaza amakuru y’imiterere
y’ubuzima bw’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bisabwe mu nyandiko
n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha;
(c) cyangwa iyo indwara ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi arwaye ishobora gutera
icyorezo cyagira ingaruka ku buzima
rusange.
UMUTWE WA V: UBURENGANZIRA
N’INSHINGANO
Icyiciro cya mbere: Uburenganzira
n’inshingano by’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku buzima bwiza Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite uburenganzira bwo kugira ubuzima bwiza,
Uburenganzira bwo guhabwa agaciro no kubahwa mu mibereho bwite Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite
articles.text:
uburenganzira bwo guhabwa agaciro no
kubahwa mu mibereho ye bwite haba mbere,
mu gihe na nyuma yo guhabwa serivisi
z’ubuvuzi .

articles.heading: Uburenganzira kuri serivisi z’ubuvuzi Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite uburenganzira bwo guhabwa serivisi
articles.text:
z’ubuvuzi ku gihe hifashishijwe imiti yizewe,
ubuhanga buzwi neza n’ikoranabuhanga mu
buvuzi.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo guhitamo serivisi z’ubuvuzi Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite uburenganzira bwo kwihitiramo serivisi
articles.text:
y’ubuvuzi imubereye n’utanga serivisi
y’ubuvuzi uyimuha. Icyakora, iyo byihutirwa
bikorwa hakurikijwe amategeko, amabwiriza
n’imirongo ngenderwaho bigenga ubuvuzi.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira kuri serivisi z’ubuvuzi zihutirwa Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite uburenganzira kuri serivisi z’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
zihutirwa no koherezwa mu kindi kigo
cy’ubuvuzi mu gihe ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
cyamwakiriye kidafite ubushobozi bwo
kumuvura.
hubahirizwa amahame agenga
umwuga wo kuvura;
(b) ku buryo buhari bwo guteza imbere
ubuzima, gukumira no gusuzuma
indwara n’uburyo butandukanye bwo
kumuha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ashobora
guhitamo;
(c) no ku byiza, ingaruka n’ikiguzi
bijyana na buri buryo bwa serivisi
y’ubuvuzi.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku buzima bw’imyororokere y’abantu
Uburenganzira bwo kudakorerwaho ibikorwa byangiza ubuzima
Uburenganzira bwo guhabwa amakuru
Uburenganzira bwo gusobanurirwa mu rurimi ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi yumva (1) Utanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi aha ukoresha
articles.text:
serivisi z’ubuvuzi amakuru ajyanye
n’imiterere y’ubuzima bwe akoresheje
ururimi yumva. Icyakora, iyo ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi adashobora kumva
rumwe mu ndimi zemewe mu butegetsi,
yishakira umusemurira mu rurimi yumva.
(2) Iyo ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite
ubumuga bwo kutumva, kutavuga
cyangwa ubukomatanyije, ukora
umwuga wo kuvura amusobanurira
akoresheje ururimi rw’amarenga

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo kubona ibiri ku ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
Uburenganzira ku kwiyemerera (1) Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite uburenganzira bwo kwiyemerera mu
articles.text:
magambo cyangwa mu nyandiko mbere
yo guhabwa serivisi y’ubuvuzi,
hakurikijwe amategeko, amabwiriza
n’imirongo ngenderwaho bigenga
ubuvuzi.
(2) Iyo ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ari
udashobora kwiyemerera, bikorwa
n’umuhagarariye.
(3) Iyo kwiyemerera bigomba gukorwa mu
nyandiko, ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
akaba afite ubumuga bumubuza
gushyira igikumwe cyangwa umukono
ku nyandiko, ishyirwaho ikimenyetso
gishingiye ku bipimo ndangamiterere ye
cyangwa ibipimo ndangamiterere ye
byihariye. Iyo ibyo bidashoboka,
inyandiko ishyirwaho igikumwe
cyangwa umukono n’umuhagarariye.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo kwanga serivisi y’ubuvuzi n’ubwo kwisubiraho ku kwiyemerera (1) Ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite
articles.text:
uburenganzira bwo kwanga guhabwa
serivisi y’ubuvuzi, kwanga ko
igikorwa cyo guhabwa serivisi
y’ubuvuzi gikomeza kumukorerwaho
no guhindura icyemezo cye iyo
bigishoboka cyangwa bigakorwa
n’umuhagarariye.
(2) Kwanga guhabwa serivisi y’ubuvuzi
cyangwa kwisubiraho ku kwiyemerera
bishobora gukorwa mu buryo ubwo ari
bwo bwose burimo inyandiko, imvugo
cyangwa amarenga bigashyirwa mu
ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi.
(3) Amakuru ajyanye no kwanga guhabwa
serivisi y’ubuvuzi cyangwa
kwisubiraho ku kwiyemerera yandikwa
mu ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura
wamwakiriye.

articles.heading: Kuvura ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi adatanze ukwiyemerera Haseguriwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 62,
articles.text:
ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gifata icyemezo cyo kuvura
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi adatanze
ukwiyemerera cyangwa umuhagarariye
atabyemeye, bikandikwa mu ifishi
y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi, mu gihe
bigaragaye ko uburwayi bushobora gushyira
ubuzima bwe mu kaga cyangwa byagira
ingaruka ku nyungu rusange hakurikijwe
amahame agenga umwuga wo kuvura.

articles.heading: Kumenyesha ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ibikorwa by’igerageza cyangwa by’ubushakashatsi Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi, icy’ubushakashatsi
articles.text:
cyangwa umushakashatsi bifuza gukora
igerageza cyangwa ubushakashatsi
hagamijwe guteza imbere ubuvuzi
babimenyesha mu nyandiko ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi mbere y’uko igerageza cyangwa
ubushakashatsi bikorwa kandi bigakorwa
hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi Kugira ngo hatangwe serivisi z’ubuvuzi zikwiye kandi yagizemo uruhare, ukoresha
articles.text:
serivisi z’ubuvuzi afite inshingano zikurikira:
(a) gutanga amakuru y’ukuri kandi yuzuye
yerekeye amateka y’ubuzima bwe
utanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi amukeneyeho,
uko ubuzima bwe bwifashe mu gihe cyo
kwisuzumisha, ibimenyetso afite n’imiti
arimo gufata cyangwa indi serivisi
y’ubuvuzi arimo guhabwa;
(b) gukurikiza inama, amabwiriza na
gahunda ahabwa n’utanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi, harimo gufata imiti nk’uko
byateganyijwe, gukurikiza ibyo asabwa
guhindura mu buzima, kwitabira
gahunda zateganyijwe no kubahiriza
uburyo bwo guhabwa serivisi y’ubuvuzi
cyangwa gahunda yo gusubiza ubuzima
bw’umurwayi mu buryo;
(c) kubaha no guha agaciro utanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi, abakozi b’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
n’abandi bakoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(d) kwirinda icyahungabanya ubuzima bwe
n’ubw’abandi;
(e) gukurikiza amabwiriza y’ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi mu gihe akoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi zitangwa n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi;
(f) kwishyura serivisi y’ubuvuzi yishyurwa
yahawe.
Icyiciro cya 2: Uburenganzira
n’inshingano by’ukora umwuga wo
kuvura

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’ukora umwuga wo kuvura Ukora umwuga wo kuvura afite uburenganzira bwo kubahwa no guhabwa
articles.text:
agaciro n’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi, ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi n’abandi bakorera ku kigo
cy’ubuvuzi, harimo –
(a) kudakorerwa ivangura iryo ari ryo
ryose;
(b) kudahozwa ku nkeke;
(c) kudakorerwa ihohoterwa iryo ari ryo
ryose ;
UMUTWE WA VI: IBIGO BY’UBUVUZI
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ibyiciro by’ibigo
by’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ukora umwuga wo kuvura UMUTWE WA VI: IBIGO BY’UBUVUZI Icyiciro cya mbere: Ibyiciro by’ibigo
articles.text: by’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Ibigo by’ubuvuzi bya Leta Ibigo by’ubuvuzi bya Leta ni ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
(a) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishingwa na Leta;
(b) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi ba nyiracyo
beguriye Leta binyuze mu
masezerano;
(c) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cy’abafatanya na
Leta ku bw’amasezerano cyahindutse
icya Leta mu buryo buteganywa
n’amasezerano;
(d) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyubatswe na Leta
ku butaka bwayo imicungire yacyo
ikegurirwa abikorera binyuze mu
masezerano.

articles.heading: Ibigo by’ubuvuzi by’abafatanya na Leta ku bw’amasezerano (1) Ibigo by’ubuvuzi by’abafatanya na Leta
articles.text:
ku bw’amasezerano harimo–
(a) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi Leta yubatse
ifatanyije n’umuntu ku giti cye,
umuryango ushingiye ku
myemerere, fondasiyo cyangwa
umuryango utari uwa Leta, ku
butaka uwo muntu, umuryango
cyangwa fondasiyo batunze ku
buryo bwemewe n’amategeko;
(b) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyubatswe
n’umuntu ku giti cye, umuryango
ushingiye ku myemerere, fondasiyo,
umuryango utari uwa Leta ku butaka
batunze ku buryo bwemewe
n’amategeko, Leta ikagira uruhare
mu kugisana, kucyagura, guhemba
abakozi cyangwa kugiha ibikoresho,
uretse mu gihe Leta yabitanze
nk’impano mu buryo bwanditse;
(c) n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyubatswe na
Leta ku butaka bw’umuntu ku giti
cye, ubw’umuryango ushingiye ku
myemerere, ubwa fondasiyo
cyangwa ubw’umuryango utari uwa
Leta.
(2) Nyir’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cy’abafatanya na
Leta ku bw’amasezerano akorana
amasezerano na Leta agaragaza
imikorere n’imikoranire, uruhare
n’inshingano bya buri ruhande.

articles.heading: Ibigo by’ubuvuzi byigenga n’imikorere yabyo (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga ni ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishingwa mu buryo
articles.text:
bwemewe n’amategeko, harimo
igishingwa –
(a) n’umuntu ku giti cye cyangwa abantu
bishyize hamwe;
(b) n’umuryango ushingiye ku
myemerere;
(c) na fondasiyo;
(d) n’umuryango utari uwa Leta;
(e) n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi Leta yegurira
abikorera binyuze mu masezerano;
(f) cyangwa n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi
cyigenga mpuzamahanga.
(2) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga cyubahiriza
amategeko n’ibipimo ngenderwaho mu
buvuzi mu Rwanda.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ishingwa, iyandikwa
n’igenzurwa by’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Ishingwa ry’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishingwa hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga kandi hashingiwe ku
articles.text:
ikarita igaragaza aho ibigo by’ubuvuzi
biherereye n’aho ibigo by’ubuvuzi bishya
biteganywa kubakwa ishyirwaho na
Minisiteri hubahirijwe igishushanyo
mbonera cy’imikoreshereze
n’imitunganyirize by’ubutaka ku rwego
rw’Igihugu.

articles.heading: Iyandikwa ry’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya Leta cyangwa icy’abafatanya na Leta ku bw’amasezerano
articles.text:
(1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya Leta cyangwa
icy’abafatanya na Leta ku
bw’amasezerano cyandikwa kandi
kigahabwa uburenganzira bwo gutanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi na Minisiteri.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibipimo
ngenderwaho n’ibindi bisabwa kugira
ngo ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya Leta
n’icy’abafatanya na Leta ku
bw’amasezerano gihabwe uburenganzira
bwo gukora.

articles.heading: Kwemerera ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga gukora (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga cyifuza gukora cyandikwa kandi kigahabwa
articles.text:
uruhushya rwo gukora mu nyandiko na
Minisiteri.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibipimo
ngenderwaho, ikiguzi cy’uruhushya rwo
gukora n’ibindi bisabwa kugira ngo
ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga gihabwe
uruhushya rwo gukora.

articles.heading: Igenzurwa ry’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gikorerwa ubugenzuzi buhoraho n’Akarere cyangwa Umujyi wa
articles.text:
Kigali na Minisiteri.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo
igenzurwa ry’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi rikorwa.
Icyiciro cya 3: Imicungire y’ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi n’iy’umutungo wacyo

articles.heading: Imicungire y’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya Leta gicungwa na Leta hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga
articles.text:
(2) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cy’abafatanya na Leta
ku bw’amasezerano gicungwa
hakurikijwe amasezerano n’amategeko
abigenga.
(3) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga gicungwa
na nyiracyo hakurikijwe amategeko
abigenga.
(4) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya Leta,
icy’abafatanya na Leta ku
bw’amasezerano cyangwa icyigenga
gicungwa hitawe ku nyungu z’ubuvuzi.

articles.heading: Umutungo w’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi n’imicungire yawo (1) Umutungo w’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cya Leta ugizwe n’ibintu byimukanwa
articles.text:
n’ibitimukanwa. Ucungwa hakurikijwe
amategeko agenga imicungire y’imari
n’umutungo bya Leta.
(2) Umutungo Leta ishyira mu kigo
cy’ubuvuzi cy’abafatanya na Leta ku
bw’amasezerano n’uwo ufatanya na Leta
ku bw’amasezerano ashyira mu kigo
cy’ubuvuzi cy’abafatanya na Leta ku
bw’amasezerano ucungwa hakurikijwe
amasezerano yashyizweho umukono
n’impande zombi.
(3) Umutungo w’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyigenga
ucungwa na nyiracyo.
Icyiciro cya 4: Inshingano
n’uburenganzira by’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Inshingano yo guteza imbere ubuzima na serivisi z’ubuvuzi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi giteza imbere ubuzima
articles.text:
muri rusange mu ifasi giherereyemo
igenwa na Minisiteri. Gishinzwe kandi –
(a) gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zo
kubahiriza uburenganzira
bw’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(b) kubahiriza ibipimo n’imirongo
ngenderwaho mu gutanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi;
(c) guha ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ibikoresho bikenewe kugira ngo
yuzuze inshingano ze;
(d) gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi bufite
ireme binyuze mu kuzamura serivisi
z’ubuvuzi zizewe, harimo –
(i) kwita ku isuku n’isukura
by’ahatangirwa serivisi
z’ubuvuzi;
(ii) kubahiriza ingamba zo kurwanya
indwara zandura;
(iii) no gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba
zigamije kugabanya ibyatera
amakosa cyangwa ibyago mu
buvuzi;
(e) kugenzura ko uruhushya rw’ukora
umwuga wo kuvura rugifite agaciro no
kumuhagarika igihe rutakigafite;
(f) gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku gihe
cyagenwe hagendewe ku ruhushya
rwo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi cyahawe;
(g) gushyikiriza urwego bireba raporo
y’ibikorwa bijyanye na serivisi
z’ubuvuzi gitanga;
(h) gushyiraho ingamba zo kurinda
amakuru y’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi;
(i) kubika ibanga ry’amakuru y’ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(j) no kugira ubufatanye n’imikoranire
n’ibindi bigo by’ubuvuzi
n’abafatanyabikorwa.
(2) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gitanga serivisi zifasha
kororoka hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga
mu buvuzi gifite kandi inshingano
zikurikira:
(a) gutanga amakuru akenewe kuri
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zerekeye kororoka
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga;
(b) gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi zo
kororoka hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi.

articles.heading: Inshingano yo kubika ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kibika ifishi y’ukoresha
articles.text:
serivisi z’ubuvuzi nibura mu gihe
cy’imyaka icumi ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
aherukira guhabwa serivisi y’ubuvuzi.
Icyakora, ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi zerekeye kororoka
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu buvuzi
ibikwa nibura igihe cy’imyaka 25 ibarwa
uhereye ku munsi aherukira guhabwa
serivisi y’ubuvuzi yerekeye kororoka
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu
buvuzi.
(2) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gishyiraho ingamba
zigamije kubuza abantu batabyemerewe
kugera ku ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi n’izo kuyirinda kwangirika
cyangwa kubura.

articles.heading: Kumenyekanisha serivisi z’ubuvuzi (1) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gifite uburenganzira bwo kumenyekanisha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
gitanga. Icyakora, kumenyekanisha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi hagamijwe
kwamamaza ntibyemewe.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi kimenyekanisha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi.
UMUTWE WA VII: UBWISHINGIZI KU
MWUGA WO KUVURA

articles.heading: Ubwishingizi ku mwuga wo kuvura (1) Ubwishingizi ku mwuga wo kuvura hakubiyemo ubwishingizi bufatwa
articles.text:
n’ukora umwuga wo kuvura n’ubufatwa
n’ikigo cy’ubuvuzi hagamijwe
kwishyura uburyozwe bukomoka kuri
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zateye ingaruka ku
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi.
(2) Ukora umwuga wo kuvura afata
ubwishingizi ku mwuga wo kuvura.
Ubwishingizi bw’ukora umwuga wo
kuvura bukubiyemo uruhare rwe n’urwo
atangirwa n’umukoresha, iyo amufite.
(3) Iyo ukora umwuga wo kuvura afite
abakoresha barenze umwe, aho akorera
hose ahafata ubwishingizi ku mwuga wo
kuvura bukubiyemo uruhare rwe n’urwa
buri mukoresha.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite ubwishingizi mu
nshingano rigena ingano y’umusanzu
w’ubwishingizi utangwa n’ukora
umwuga wo kuvura n’utangwa
n’umukoresha.
(5) Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gifata ubwishingizi ku
mwuga wo kuvura n’ubwishingizi
bw’inyubako n’ibizirimo.
UMUTWE WA VIII: AMAKOSA,
IBYAHA N’IBIHANO
Icyiciro cya mbere: Amakosa n’ibihano
Akiciro ka mbere: Amakosa n’ibihano byo
mu rwego rw’umwuga bihabwa ukora
umwuga wo kuvura

articles.heading: Kudatanga raporo ihabwa ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku gihe Ukora umwuga wo kuvura udatanze raporo
articles.text:
ihabwa ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi ku gihe,
aba akoze ikosa. Iyo bitagize ingaruka
zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
ukora umwuga wo kuvura ahanishwa
kwihanangirizwa. Iyo bigize ingaruka
zikomeye k’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
ukora umwuga wo kuvura ahanishwa
guhagarikwa by’agateganyo igihe kitari
munsi y’amezi 3 ariko kitarenze amezi 6.

articles.heading: Kudakora inshingano zo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi, kuzikora nabi cyangwa kutazikora ku gihe
articles.text:
Ukora umwuga wo kuvura udakora
inshingano ze zo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
uzikora nabi cyangwa utazikora ku gihe, aba
akoze ikosa. Iyo bitagize ingaruka zikomeye
ku ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi, ukora
umwuga wo kuvura ahanishwa kugawa. Iyo
bigize ingaruka zikomeye ku ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi, ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ahanishwa guhagarikwa by’agateganyo igihe
kitari munsi y’amezi 6 ariko kitarenze amezi
12 cyangwa gukurwa ku rutonde rw’abakora
umwuga wo kuvura.

articles.heading: Gukoresha imvugo itesha agaciro, gutuka, gusuzugura ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi, kudatanga amakuru
articles.text:
cyangwa gutanga amakuru atari yo,
kugandisha undi cyangwa kwiha
ububasha
Ukora umwuga wo kuvura ukoze kimwe mu
bikorwa bikurikira:
(a) ukoresheje imvugo, inyandiko cyangwa
ibimenyetso bitesha agaciro,
ihungabanya, utuka, cyangwa usuzugura
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(b) udatanze amakuru cyangwa utanze
amakuru atariyo mu bijyanye n’umwuga
wo kuvura hakurikijwe amategeko
abigenga;
(c) ugandishije ukora umwuga wo kuvura
kugira ngo ateshuke ku nshingano ze mu
gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(d) cyangwa yihaye ububasha bwo gutanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi zirenze izo yemerewe
gutanga atabifitiye ubushobozi cyangwa
atabiherewe uburenganzira bwihariye;
aba akoze ikosa. Iyo bitagize ingaruka
zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
ukora umwuga wo kuvura ahanishwa
guhagarikwa by’agateganyo mu gihe kitari
munsi y’ukwezi 1 ariko kitarenze amezi 3
adakora umwuga wo kuvura. Iyo bigize
ingaruka zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi, ukora umwuga wo kuvura
ahanishwa guhagarikwa by’agateganyo mu
gihe cy’amezi 6 adakora umwuga wo kuvura.

articles.heading: Guhimba inyandiko, gusiba cyangwa kwangiza amakuru y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi Ukora umwuga wo kuvura ukoze kimwe mu
articles.text:
bikorwa bikurikira :
(a) guhimba inyandiko zijyanye
n’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi;
(b) kwangiza cyangwa gusiba amakuru
yerekeye ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
ajyanye n’umwuga wo kuvura;
aba akoze ikosa. Iyo bitagize ingaruka
zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
ukora umwuga wo kuvura ahanishwa
guhagarikwa mu gihe kitari munsi y’amezi 3
ariko kitarenze amezi 6. Iyo bigize ingaruka
zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi,
ukora umwuga wo kuvura ahanishwa
kuvanwa ku rutonde rw’abagize urugaga
rw’abakora umwuga wo kuvura.

articles.heading: Guhamywa n’urukiko icyaha gikomeye cyangwa icyaha cy’ubugome Ukora umwuga wo kuvura uhamijwe
articles.text:
n’urukiko icyaha gikomeye cyangwa icyaha
cy’ubugome akurwa ku rutonde rw’abakora
umwuga wo kuvura.
Akiciro ka 2: Amakosa n’ibihano byo mu
rwego rw’ubutegetsi bihabwa ikigo
cy’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Gukoresha ukora umwuga wo kuvura udafite uruhushya rwo gukora umwuga wo kuvura Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gikoresha ukora umwuga
articles.text:
wo kuvura udafite uruhushya rwo gukora
umwuga wo kuvura kiba gikoze ikosa, iyo
ari –
(a) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze,
gihanishwa kwihanangirizwa no
gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
500.000;
(b) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi bwisumbuye,
serivisi z’ubuvuzi bw’ikirenga,
gihanishwa gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
20.000.000.

articles.heading: Kudahagarika ukora umwuga wo kuvura udafite uruhushya rwo gukora umwuga wo kuvura
Gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kitemerewe, gukorera ku ruhushya rutagifite agaciro cyangwa
articles.text: gukora ibikorwa by’uburiganya

articles.heading: Gukora nta ruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi gitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
articles.text:
nta ruhushya kiba gikoze ikosa, iyo ari –
(a) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze, gihanishwa
guhagarikwa kugeza igihe kiboneye
uruhushya no gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
5.000.000;
(b) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bwisumbuye, gihanishwa
guhagarikwa kugeza igihe kiboneye
uruhushya no gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
10.000.000;
(c) cyangwa ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku
rwego rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga
serivisi z’ubuvuzi bw’ikirenga,
gihanishwa guhagarikwa kugeza igihe
kiboneye uruhushya no gutanga
ihazabu ya FRW 20.000.000.

articles.heading: Kutabika ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kitabika ifishi y’ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi nk’uko biteganywa n’iri
articles.text:
tegeko, kiba gikoze ikosa, iyo ari –
(a) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bw’ibanze, gihanishwa
gutanga ihazabu ya FRW 500.000.
Iyo bigize ingaruka zikomeye ku
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
gihanishwa gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
1.000.000;
(b) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bwisumbuye, gihanishwa
gutanga ihazabu ya FRW 2.000.000.
Iyo bigize ingaruka zikomeye ku
ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
gihanishwa gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
4.000.000;
bw’ibanze, gihanishwa gutanga ihazabu
ya FRW 500.000. Iyo bigize ingaruka
zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi z’ubuvuzi
gihanishwa guhagarikwa by’agateganyo
mu gihe kingana n’amezi 2 cyangwa
gutanga ihazabu ya FRW 5.000.000;
(b) ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego rw’ibigo
by’ubuvuzi bitanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
bwisumbuye, gihanishwa gutanga
ihazabu ya FRW 1.000.000. Iyo bigize
ingaruka zikomeye ku ukoresha serivisi
z’ubuvuzi gihanishwa guhagarikwa
by’agateganyo mu gihe kingana n’amezi
2 cyangwa gutanga ihazabu ya FRW
10.000.000;
(c) cyangwa ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kiri ku rwego
rw’ibigo by’ubuvuzi bitanga serivisi
z’ubuvuzi bw’ikirenga, gihanishwa
gutanga ihazabu ya FRW 2.000.000. Iyo
bigize ingaruka zikomeye ku ukoresha
serivisi z’ubuvuzi gihanishwa
guhagarikwa by’agateganyo mu gihe
kingana n’amezi 2 cyangwa gutanga
ihazabu ya FRW 20.000.000.

articles.heading: Kwishyuza serivisi z’ubuvuzi ikiguzi gitandukanye n’igiteganywa n’iteka rya Minisitiri rigena
articles.text: igiciro cya serivisi z’ubuvuzi

articles.heading: Kutubahiriza ibipimo n’imirongo ngenderwaho mu gutanga serivisi z’ubuvuzi
Kumenyekanisha serivisi z’ubuvuzi hagamijwe kwamamaza Ikigo cy’ubuvuzi kimenyekanisha serivisi
articles.text:
ishobora kugihagarika kugeza igihe
kirikosoreye. Iyo cyahanishijwe igihano cyo
guhagarikwa by’agateganyo, Minisiteri
ishobora kutacyemerera kongera gukora iyo
kitarakosora ikosa ryatumye gihagarikwa
n’ubwo igihe cyo guhagarikwa cyaba
cyararangiye.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ibyaha n’ibihano

articles.heading: Kutemerera ikigo cy’ubuvuzi cyahanwe kongera gukora Icyiciro cya 2: Ibyaha n’ibihano
Gushyira mu myanya myibarukiro y’umugore urusoro cyangwa intanga zitari iz’umuntu Ukora umwuga wo kuvura ushyira mu
articles.text:
myanya myibarukiro y’umugore urusoro
rutari urw’umuntu cyangwa intanga zitari
iz’umuntu aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe
n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi
y’imyaka 10 ariko kitarenze imyaka 15 no
gutanga ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW
